blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is hands-off on the voting threshold issue in the impeachment proceedings against Vice President Sara Duterte, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said on Wednesday. The statement came after four retired Supreme Court justices served as amici curiae, or friends of the court, before the Senate Impeachment Court as senator-judges revisit the voting threshold required to convict Duterte. READ: Here’s what amici curiae say about the impeachment voting threshold The four are retired Chief Justices Artemio Panganiban, Reynato Puno, and Hilario Davide Jr., as well as retired Associate Justice Adolfo Azcuna.
